Every A/V packet hash/PTS/DTS/duration matches original; full candidate decode clean; final video/audio/subtitle structural check PASS. Frame at 8 s extracted and visually inspected. Evidence and principal commands: local/summaries/me-at-the-zoo-dp9/smoke-test.md; same folder retains archive, pre-subs original, probes, logs, embedded SRT, frame and provenance. close_reason: Live download and local ASR smoke-test passed; Matroska, full decode, exact A/V packet fidelity, subtitle text/timing, provenance cmp and visual extraction verified.
